descriptiveFindings.matchedScalePairs: Four of five matched scale events show large negative P2-minus-P1 onset-logit deltas around -10 to -12; the fifth is about -1.03. Bias-cancellation identities hold to floating-point tolerance, so those deltas arise from changed hidden representations projected through fixed onset weights, not a changing bias.
descriptiveFindings.singleNotePair: The one matched single-note event shows an onset-logit delta of about -1.66.
descriptiveFindings.stateEvidence: P2 chord and PalmMute exact-center true-vs-silence state margins are frequently strongly negative; PalmMute remains a clear state/representation problem in addition to onset failure.
descriptiveFindings.controls: Sustain controls generally show suppressed onset admissions, while P2 reference attacks still fail onset admission. These controls are descriptive and do not establish a causal repair.
descriptiveFindings.temporalEvidence: Fixed adjacent-frame feature deltas were recorded for attack and control frames; no tuned temporal detector was fit.

interpretation.reasonForInconclusive: Only six conservative cross-performer event correspondences exist, with none for chords or PalmMute; observational projection/temporal statistics cannot by themselves establish causality.

decision.nextPermissibleWork: Design-only for one predeclared capped controlled intervention, with explicit split/comparator and no execution until separately authorized.
